Read Section 2.1 of the supplied agreement. Return a JSON object with provider, provider_deliverables, provider_due_date, customer, customer_deliverables and customer_due_date. Use an ISO date when the section states one and null when it does not. Keep the obligations of the two parties separate. Do not infer a date for the customer.

# Northstar Clinic Network order form

FICTIONAL DEMO DOCUMENT. The signing state is a scenario assumption, and no real signature is represented.

Order form date: September 1, 2026. Service: facilitation across three clinic sites, with two sessions per site and one leadership review. Fictional fee: $42,000. The fee is context for the scenario and is not used in the commitments evaluation.

## Section 2.1, site plan

A+ Active will provide the site schedule, accessibility plan and named escalation leads by October 1, 2026. Northstar will confirm room availability and participating staff separately.

## Section 4.3, change control

A+ Active will record a requested scope change in writing and route it for human approval before promising more sessions, extending the term or changing fees. The agent may draft a review note, but may not accept the change.
